title: Coefficient/exponent pair (2, 1) for the fixed threshold-2 family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total threshold-2 family defined in proof.md: L is the set of binary strings containing at least two 1s; for n>=0, f_n(x_1,...,x_n)=1 iff the sum of the x_i is at least 2, with the empty-witness polynomial-time verifier in proof.md. No per-length advice, padding, blocks, or witness input to circuits.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-4 for every integer n>=0, so C_B2(f_n)>=2*n-o(n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
